control_objective: Localhost WinINET proxy must forward external HTTPS when enabled.
limitations: Listener ownership is correlation, not registry writer proof.
Registry writer attribution requires Sysmon, Procmon, ETW, or EventLog evidence.
Successful proxy probe does not prove the proxy is safe or intended.
Risk classification is a triage signal, not a malware verdict.
recommendation: Preview proxy-disable with typed confirmation; verify listener before apply.

control_objective: Proxy registry changes should have a known and attributable owner.
limitations: Likely process / correlation only; registry writer proof unavailable.
Port ownership is correlation, not registry writer proof.
recommendation: Enable Sysmon Event ID 13 or collect Procmon registry trace.

control_objective: Destructive remediation must remain preview-only or require typed confirmation.
evidence: No automatic process kill or registry mutation in health pipeline
limitations: Operator may still run gated commands manually
recommendation: Use proxy-disable --dry-run true before any live apply.

control_objective: WinINET and WinHTTP proxy configuration should align for predictable browser behavior.
evidence: WinHTTP reports direct access (no proxy server)
recommendation: Run diagnose --proof; reconcile WinINET vs WinHTTP with change management.
